rows.grounds: Fused form: adhasthāt (below) + vīra-kāṇḍasya (of the vīra-staff/section); internal sandhi noted, token kept unsplit.

items.question: What defining characteristics mark the plank situated below the vīra-staff?
premises: A location below the vīra-staff is specified.
A plank associated with that location is identified.
The characteristics of that plank are presented for hearing.
items.inference: The plank below the vīra-staff possesses specific defining characteristics to be learned.
uncertainties: The precise architectural referent of vīrakāṇḍa is not fully determined from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Hear the characteristics of the plank below the vīra-staff.
